Join us

Build something that outlives your semester.

Members of Enactus ARSD design ventures, run fieldwork, negotiate with suppliers, tell stories and manage money — real operating experience, aimed at real people.

Join as a student member

Volunteer with a project

Not on the core team but want to help? Project teams periodically need volunteers for drives, sales days and outreach sessions.

E Enactus ARSD

Enactus ARSD is the student-led Enactus chapter of Atma Ram Sanatan Dharma College, University of Delhi. We use entrepreneurial action to create livelihoods, dignity and well-being in the communities around our campus.
